fix(ci): align psdk release-js with Node 20

Summary:
- switch the tagged release-js workflow from Node 24 to Node 20
- keep the release path aligned with the existing passing check-js runtime

Rationale:
- Node 24 pulls a canvas ABI without a prebuilt binary and falls back to a
  system-library compile that fails in the GitHub runner environment
- the same psdk JS install succeeds on Node 20 and the branch check workflow
  already uses that runtime successfully

Tests:
- gh run view 23442287243 --repo 0xfe10/dynamic-actions --job 68196289355 --log
- docker run --rm -v /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-36/psdk:/src -w /tmp node:24-bookworm bash -lc 'cp -a /src /tmp/psdk && cd /tmp/psdk/js && corepack enable && yarn install'
- docker run --rm -v /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-36/psdk:/src -w /tmp node:20-bookworm bash -lc 'cp -a /src /tmp/psdk && cd /tmp/psdk/js && corepack enable && yarn install'
- git -C /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-36/psdk diff --check
- ruby -e 'require "yaml"; release = YAML.load_file("/code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-36/psdk/.github/dyn-workflows/release.yml"); check = YAML.load_file("/code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-36/psdk/.github/dyn-workflows/check.yml"); abort unless release["jobs"]["release-js"]["steps"][2]["with"]["node-version"] == check["jobs"]["check-js"]["steps"][2]["with"]["node-version"]'
